newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM Q1 LOSS 1.62 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM Q1 LOSS 1.62 MLN LATS.

text.p: Olainfarm, a pharmaceutical company to be listed on the bourse from next week, registered a first quarter loss of 1.62 million lats on turnover of 1.79 million, the stock exchange said on Thursday.

Olainfarm will be traded on the secondary list from May 9. It is 51 percent owned by company Olmafarm, which holds 1.53 million shares and 44 percent or 1.33 million shares have been sold by public offer for vouchers.
The company's total share capital is 11.5 millin shares and its balance sheet total is 11.57 million lats. The basic capital is 6.74 million lats.
Olainfarm also has long-term debts of 2.2 million lats and short-term debts of 5.69 milion lats, the bourse said.
